title: How To Land Your First $3K AI Automation Client
description:
Your first AI automation build is worth three grand. And you can land that client in under a month.

Pick your niche with a 4-point filter. You understand their workflow, they can pay 3 to 5K, they've got 5+ recurring tasks eating their week, and they can't build it themselves.

Seven niches that bleed hours every week: real estate, marketing agencies, e-commerce, professional services, content creators, financial advisors, healthcare.

Now build one free case study. Cold message 10 businesses and offer to save them 5+ hours a week for just 2 hours of their time.

Then measure it. Saved 8 hours a week on reporting, plus a testimonial = 10 grand in free marketing.

Post the before and after. Reports in 3 minutes instead of 3 hours.

Send 3 to 5 specific DMs a day.
Then ask that free client for intros. One referral beats 10 cold emails.
Do this and you've got paying clients in a month, 10K a month in 90 days.
This window is wide open right now. In 18 months it's gone.
Follow for more ways to make real money with AI.
